descriptions.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散：随着原子钟倒数归零，他发射了一群可自我复制的纳米机器人！

根据计算，这群纳米机器人的抛物线对准的是[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系中的另一颗行星，[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]，预计将在一个月内抵达。

它们到达后将会发生什么，我们尚不得而知……
descriptions.en:
Researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision found on [From.From.From.GetName] for the past 42 years and 3 days.

Several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant: the clock has just now reached its momentous deadline, ejecting a stream of self-replicating nanites!

These nanites are streaming on a trajectory towards another planet in the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] System, [atomic_clock_planet.GetName], projected to arrive within the month.

Whatever may happen once they arrive remains to be seen...

label.zh: 有什么消息及时通知我们。

options.script:
name = "distar.311.a"
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = distar.312 days = 30 } }

label.zh: 绝不能接受。对这群纳米机器人开火！

tooltips.zh: 命令我们处于该星系中的人手，摧毁从原子钟里出现的纳米机器人群。
tooltips.en: Order our crew in the system to destroy the nanite stream being emitted from the atomic clock.

descriptions.zh:
[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系小行星带中弹射而出的纳米机器人群，在[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]着陆了！这群纳米机器人以惊人速度迅速繁殖，只用了几个小时便覆盖了整颗行星的表面，并开始对其进行环境改造，将其转化为§Y盖亚星球§!！

环境改造完成后几小时，所有参与改造纳米机器人全部自动关闭，并且腐烂至无法辨识的地步，直接导致我们无法从中提取任何信息与情报。

然而，它们的残留物为这个已经变得十分吸引人的星球表面增添了不少价值可观的金属合成物。
descriptions.en:
The nanite stream ejected by the atomic clock in the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] system asteroid belt has made planetfall on [atomic_clock_planet.GetName]! Replicating at an incredible rate, the nanites covered the entire surface of the planet in a period of hours, proceeding to terraform it into a §YGaia World§!!

Hours after the completion of the terraforming event, the nanites involved in the process deactivated and decayed beyond recognition, leaving us with little ability to extract any information from them.

However, their remains have peppered the surface of the now-very-tempting planet with valuable metallic composites.

descriptions.zh:
据我们正在观察[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系的军官称，虽然大部分流向[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]的纳米机器人群已被炮火摧毁，却还是有数量难以统计的仍处于活跃状态纳米机器人到达了该行星表面。

它们的目的至今尚不明确，不过自从着陆后，它们就开始以一种似乎随机的方式开始了疾速繁殖。

[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]现在已被这种能够自我复制的显微级物质构成的粘液覆盖了。
descriptions.en:
Our military officers observing the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] System report that while the vast majority of the nanites streaming towards [atomic_clock_planet.GetName] were fired upon and destroyed, an undetectable quantity of still-active nanites managed to reach the planet's surface.

Whatever purpose they were meant for remains unknown, but once reaching the planet's surface they have begun to replicate rapidly in a seemingly random fashion.

[atomic_clock_planet.GetName] is now covered in a moving slurry of microscopic replicators.

descriptions.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散：随着原子钟倒数归零，他发射了一群可自我复制的纳米机器人！

纳米机器人把这颗小行星变化成了一艘十分神奇的无人军事舰船，随后便离开了小行星的表面。

如果有兴趣，我们完全可以将其据为己有。
descriptions.en:
Researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision found on [From.From.From.GetName] for the past 42 years and 3 days.

Several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant: the clock has just now reached its momentous deadline, ejecting a stream of self-replicating nanites!

These nanites left the surface of the asteroid, where they have coalesced into a fascinating, unmanned military vessel.

It is ours for the taking, should we so desire.

descriptions.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散：随着原子钟倒数归零，他发射了一群可自我复制的纳米机器人！

纳米机器人在[From.From.From.GetName]表面建造了某种高级的计算网络。网络目前处于关闭状态，似乎也没有任何人工智能存在的迹象，而纳米机器人在建造完成后也都自动关闭了。

我们的研究人员对于这个网络的存在目的感到十分疑惑。要想研究这玩意，估计够让他们忙上好一阵了。
descriptions.en:
Researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision found on [From.From.From.GetName] for the past 42 years and 3 days.

Several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant: the clock has just now reached its momentous deadline, ejecting a stream of self-replicating nanites!

The nanites have constructed some manner of advanced computational network on the surface of [From.From.From.GetName]. The network is inactive, and seemingly devoid of any AI, the nanites having deactivated the instant its construction was complete.

Our researchers are somewhat baffled as to the purpose of the network. Studying it should keep them occupied for quite some time.

descriptions.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

现在几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散，同样消失的还有[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]的大部分。

随着原子钟倒数归零，他向[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]上的某个接收器发射了一个信号，触发了一场灾难性的热核爆炸，摧毁了整个行星和定居于此的原始文明。

在我们的科学家还在为这次精准定时的毁灭行为背后的缘由争论不休的时候，这台原子钟依旧在滴答作响，仿佛下方的荒凉死寂和它毫无关系一样。
descriptions.en:
For the past 42 years and 3 days, researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision, found on [From.From.From.GetName].

Now several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant, along with most of [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName].

As the clock reached its momentous deadline it transmitted a signal to a receiver on [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName], triggering a thermonuclear explosion of such devastating power it laid waste to the entire planet and the primitive society residing there.

While our scientists debate the reason behind this carefully timed act of annihilation, the atomic clock continues to tick, undisturbed by the desolation below.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]轨道上的船壳是维克塔·泽沃尼亚号的残骸，它是一艘巨大的亚光速世代舰船，属于名为马达克·沃尔的非常唯心主义的外星物种。

尽管船上的生命已被无情地清除，舰长日志中仍然详细记录了马达克的悲惨之旅。在遭到被称为“躯壳”的可怕存在围追堵截之后，他们逃离了故乡，寻找遥远的乐园星球——传说中的乐土帕丽达雅，它只会对获选者显露真面貌。不过以其舰船的状况来看，他们被攻击者追上了。

我们是否该提取舰船的导航设备，并解密其目的地？
descriptions.en:
The hulk orbiting [From.GetName] is all that remains of the Vechtar Zavonia, a massive sub-light generation ship belonging to a deeply religious alien race called the Mardak Vol.

Though the ship has been ruthlessly purged of all life, the Mardaks' ill-fated journey has been detailed in the captain's logs. After being hunted to near extinction by nightmarish beings referred to as 'Vessels', they fled their homeworld in search of a distant paradise planet - the mythical promised land Paridayda, that would reveal itself only to the chosen ones. Judging by the state of their ship, however, their attackers caught up with them.

Shall we extract the ship's navigational drive and decrypt its destination?

owner = { add_resource = { influence = 50 } }

descriptions.zh:
解开维克塔·泽沃尼亚号的导航设备加密并不轻松，但多亏了对寻找马达克·沃尔族的理想乡着迷的首席科学官[vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]，我们最终成功了。

更令人担忧的是，这一发现不知怎的被透露给了公众，人们现在和[vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]一样决心要在一颗乐园星球上安家。
descriptions.en:
Cracking the encoding algorithms on the Vechtar Zavonia's navigational drive was no small feat, but thanks to head researcher [vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName], who seems to have developed an unusual obsession with finding the Mardak Vol's utopian world, we have finally succeeded.

More worryingly, the discovery has somehow leaked to the public who now share [vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]'s fixation with settling a paradise planet.

label.zh: 没有什么能阻止我们进入乐园。
label.en: Nothing can keep us out of paradise.

label.zh: 终止计划。这是徒劳之举。
label.en: Abort. This is a fool's errand.

descriptions.zh:
第二次，继而再三确认导航系统的坐标后，我们不得不承认马达科-沃尔的天堂行星是一个只有荒原的荒芜星球。

尽管我们不能排除这种可能性：马达科所认为的天堂与我们的常识不同，但[utopian_planet.GetName]表面上的弹坑给出了另一种答案。这艘船的船长和乘员并没有简单的就接受了挫折。
descriptions.en:
After double- and triple-checking the navigational drive's coordinates, we have been forced to concede that where the Mardak Vol's paradisaical planet should have been are only the desolate plains of a barren world.

Though we cannot eliminate the possibility that the Mardaks' idea of paradise was wildly different to our own, the bomb-scarred surface of [utopian_planet.GetName] tells a different story. The ship's captain and crew have not taken the disappointment lightly.

label.zh: 这不可能！再去确认一次坐标！！
label.en: This cannot be! Quadruple-check the coordinates!!

descriptions.zh:
我们终于发现了马达科-沃尔的秘密！

当我们把探测器向[utopian_planet.GetName]的地表发射时，它仅仅触碰到大气层就被弹开了，这让船员们怀疑其中另有隐情。进一步深入的研究发现我们所看见的星球表面仅仅是一层能量护盾，向外投射着荒芜废土的假象，而在这护盾背后，一颗生机勃勃的盖亚星球藏匿其中，证实着马达科-沃尔的传说所言非虚。

不仅如此，当船员们降下护盾时，他们还发现了一个由一种哺乳动物和真菌的共生体组成的石器时代的文明，平和地生活在他们简陋的聚落中，对刚刚发生的一切和我们的存在一无所知。而传说中梦魇般的“血裔”，也仅仅在他们的口口相传中继续存在。
descriptions.en:
We have finally uncovered the Mardak Vol's secret!

It was when a probe, destined for the planet's surface, bounced off its atmosphere that the crew began to suspect [utopian_planet.GetName] was not what it seemed. Closer studies revealed that what looked like the planet surface was in fact an energy shield, upon which a barren world's texture was projected, and hidden below it, a lush Gaia planet reminiscent of the Mardaks' prophecies.

But that isn't all! As the crew deactivated the shield they discovered a peaceful stone age civilization consisting of a symbiotic union between mammals and fungi who live in crude huts, oblivious to the outside world. The nightmarish 'Vessels' live on only as mythical beings in their legends.

options.script: name = distar.1003.a
name = distar.1003.b

descriptions.zh: [country_that_discovered_mardak_vol.GetName]在我们领地内的一颗盖亚星球上，发现了一个隐秘的[GetPreFTLLower]文明。星球似乎被某种复杂的能源护盾保护，使它看起来像是一颗死寂星球。我们尚未判明是谁以及为什么将它藏起来，因为那些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种明显没有足够的科技实力。他们似乎是哺乳动物与菌类形成的某种共生关系，而且在我们看来，他们完全无害。
descriptions.en: The [country_that_discovered_mardak_vol.GetName] has discovered a secret [GetPreFTLLower] society hidden on a Gaia planet within our borders. The planet seems to have been shielded by some sort of sophisticated energy field, making it appear as if it were a barren world when it was not. We have yet to determine who hid it and why, as the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] clearly lack the technology for it themselves. They seem to be a sort of symbiotic union between fungoid and mammal and, as far as we can tell, they are utterly harmless.

label.zh: 判断一颗星球绝不能只看表面。
label.en: Never judge a planet by its cover.

options.script: name = distar.1004.a

descriptions.zh: 一个先前从未遭遇过的智慧哺乳动物联络了我们，事关仍居住在[utopian_planet.GetName]上的远古马达克·沃尔族。事情似乎非常紧急。
descriptions.en: We are being hailed by a previously unencountered species of sapient mammal regarding the ancient Mardak Vol still residing on [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems very urgent.

descriptions.zh: 一个先前从未遭遇过的智慧哺乳动物联络了我们，事关仍居住在[utopian_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种。事情似乎非常紧急。
descriptions.en: We are being hailed by a previously unknown species of sapient mammal regarding the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] residing on [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems very urgent.

descriptions.zh:
你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是沃尔族，我们和平而来。

我们发现你们的一颗星球感染了马达克。它是一种寄生性真菌生物，千百年来一直危害着我们一族，将其宿主变成傀儡，而你们就是它的下一个目标！

我们本以为已将其彻底消灭，但我们的年度星系扫描却发现[utopian_planet.GetName]上还存活着许多。但不用担心，我们知道该怎么办……
descriptions.en:
Well met, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Vol and we come in peace.

We have discovered that one of your planets has been infested with Mardak. It is a parasitic fungoid that has preyed upon our kind for eons, turning its hosts into mindless puppets, and you are its next targets!

We thought we had eradicated it for good when our annual galaxy scan revealed a thriving population on [utopian_planet.GetName]. But fear not, we know just what to do...

label.zh: 无稽之谈，他们人畜无害！
绝不允许你们伤害他们！

descriptions.zh:
注意：我们将开始轨道灭绝协议倒计时，3，2，1……已向感染者释放空气传播菌类溶剂-X。敌对媒介已被清除！

不要担心，你侦测到的任何环境变化都不是暂时的，而且无法恢复……

我们感谢你们的合作。

我们是沃尔族，我们和平而来。

和平……
descriptions.en:
Be advised: We are commencing orbital extermination protocols in 3, 2, 1...Air-borne dissolvent Fungo-X released onto infected populations. Hostile agents neutralized!

Do not be alarmed, any environmental changes you may be registering are not temporary and completely irreversible...

We thank you for your cooperation.

We are the Vol. We come in peace.

Peace...

options.script: name = distar.1008.a

descriptions.zh: 频道里只有杂讯。我们失去了与沃尔族的联络。
descriptions.en: The channel crackles and pops. We have lost our connection with the Vol.

options.script: name = distar.1013.a

descriptions.zh:
原始的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]！当你醒来时发现马达克镶进你的[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]时会有何感想？菌类首先会控制你的神经系统，然后一个细胞接一个细胞地控制你的全身！你的血肉会开裂，你的精神会随之崩溃！

幸运的是，[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，那一天永远不会到来。我们不会允许它发生的。

我们是沃尔族。我们将……和平归来。
descriptions.en:
Basic [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! How do you think you will like it when you wake up with Mardak lodged in your [From.GetSpeciesOrganName]s, and your flesh is crawling and your mind cracking as the fungus hijacks first your nervous system, then your entire body, cell by cell?

Lucky for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], that day will never come to pass. We cannot allow it.

We are the Vol. We will return...in peace.

options.script: name = distar.1009.a

descriptions.zh:
我们侦测到了一支敌方舰队，带着沃尔族的通讯特征，正笔直前往[utopian_planet.GetName]。看来他们是为仍居住在星球上的马达克而来……

他们没有回应我们的联络。
descriptions.en:
We have detected a hostile fleet, bearing the Vol communications signature, headed straight for [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems they have come for the Mardak still living on the planet...

They are not responding to our hails.

options.script: name = distar.1011.a

descriptions.zh: 沃尔族在帝国安全方面可不敢有丝毫的大意，在他们用自己的全部核武力量攻击帕丽达雅并将马达克·沃尔族那美丽富饶的家乡变为一片焦土之后，沃尔族在地表的焦土上洒下杀真菌剂，彻底消灭了马达克·沃尔族。不管马达克是否有危险性，那寄生的真菌体已经不复存在了。
descriptions.en: The Vol do not gamble with national security. After unleashing their entire nuclear arsenal upon Paridayda, turning the Mardak Vol's formerly lush homeworld into ash, they doused the fiery wreckage in fungicide, dissolving the last remains of the Mardak Vol into a toxic slush. Dangerous or not, the parasitic fungoids are no more.

options.script: name = distar.1016.a

descriptions.zh: 我们终于在马达克·沃尔族的乐园星球帕丽黛达上安家了。人们正在欢庆，因为有一天，他们的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]也能在[utopian_planet.GetName]的沙丘、花园与清泉中嬉戏！
descriptions.en: We have finally settled the Mardak Vol's paradise world, Paridayda, and our citizens are rejoicing at the thought that one day their [From.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] too may frolic among the sandy dunes, lush gardens and crystal springs of [utopian_planet.GetName]!!

descriptions.zh:
在对[From.GetName]轨道上的平台进行研究后，我们发现它是一种复杂且有些古怪的外星设计。其防水机械与先进气候控制表明，它是由一种会分泌大量液体的物种制造的，很可能是软体动物。

在故障之前，它曾用微波束加热恒星大气层的一部分，诱发持续的大规模喷发，可以极大地增加太阳风的流出。这些能源随后由轨道空间站收集。

该平台是按某种非常实验性的概念设计的。
descriptions.en:
Closer inspection of the platform orbiting [From.GetName] has revealed that it is of a complex, somewhat erratic, alien design. The waterproofed machinery and advanced climate control suggest it was built for a lifeform that secreted a rich amount of fluids, very likely of the molluscoid variety.

Before falling into disrepair, microwave beams were used to heat regions of the star's atmosphere, provoking large sustained eruptions that increased the solar wind outflow significantly. The energy was then harvested with an orbital mine.

The platform is designed around some highly experimental concepts.

options.script: name = distar.1020.b

descriptions.zh:
在大量修复工作之后，平台已经上线，而恒星现在正向宇宙中喷发大量的能源。但这一路上并非一帆风顺。

当大型微波束初次启动时，工程师们几乎引发了一场连锁反应，后果可能导致一场巨大的恒星爆发，将平台以及星系中所有的星球全都摧毁。原来远古外星蓝图与使用说明中存在着大量计算错误，程度严重到可使平台无法运作。

幸好我们及时发现了错误，并调整了微波束的强度，而太阳风的流出也稳定了下来。
descriptions.en:
After extensive repairs the platform has been brought online and the star is now hurling massive amounts of energy into the cosmos. But the journey there has not been without its hurdles.

When the giant microwave beams were first activated, the engineers nearly set off a chain reaction that could have ended in a solar eruption so massive it would have blasted the platform and all system planets out of existence. As it turns out, the ancient alien blueprints and manuals were riddled with miscalculations so severe that the platform would have been inoperable.

Luckily the mistakes were caught in time, the strength of the beams has since been calibrated, and the solar wind outflow has been stabilized.

label.zh: 一颗只属于我们的太阳能电池！
label.en: A solar battery, just for us!

label.zh: 哎，软体动物……身子软，脑子也软……
label.en: Ah, Mollusks. Mushy bodies, mushy minds...

descriptions.zh: [star_lifting_ship.GetName]的船员们并没有花太多时间就得出结论：这个恒星平台的设计，用科学专员[star_lifting_leader.GetName]的话来说，是疯子的杰作。微波束非常粗劣，未经校准，而且在正常运转之前还需要大量的打磨。不过，它们很快就被证明是上好的武器。
descriptions.en: It did not take the crew of the [star_lifting_ship.GetName] long to conclude that the design of the star platform was, in Science Officer [star_lifting_leader.GetName]'s own words, the work of madmen. The microwave beams were crude, miscalibrated, and would have needed much refinement before they would work as intended. However, they soon proved to make excellent weapons.

descriptions.zh: 我们将软体动物微波束改造成武器的尝试……壮观地失败了。在启动时，我们才发现微波束的设计烂到简直无法用语言形容，最终这一科学的失败化作一团壮观的蘑菇云，而我们的科研团队则在千钧一发之际逃了出来。
descriptions.en: Our attempt to weaponize the Molluscoid microwave beams has failed... spectacularly. On activation, it turned out that the design of the beams was faulty beyond comprehension and the science crew only narrowly escaped the platform as it exploded in a magnificent mushroom-shaped display of scientific failure.

label.zh: 这些软体动物根本就不该捣鼓科学……
label.en: Those Molluscoids had no business doing science...

descriptions.zh: 观测站上的所有数据储存设备都已被清空，并且所有可指向其原主人的证据也都已被小心翼翼地抹去。[big_rip_planet.GetName]上明显出了什么差错。智慧生命曾经存在的唯一迹象，就是散布在星球上的半完成的大都市废墟，似乎在建造中途就被放弃了。
descriptions.en: All the observation post's data storage units have been wiped and extensive care has been taken to eliminate any evidence that could lead back to its owners. Something clearly went wrong on [big_rip_planet.GetName]. The only signs of intelligent life are the crumbling husks of half-finished megacities, seemingly abandoned mid-construction, scattered across its surface and the looming holotemple in their midst.

descriptions.zh:
尽管他们拼命试图掩盖，观测者拙劣的干预痕迹仍在[big_rip_planet.GetName]上随处可见……

证据表明，星球上原本居住着一个正在宗教觉醒的过程之中的以灵能相连的植物集体意识。此时一个被称为守门者的神秘外星种族毫无预兆地突然降临。从那时起，这个植物物种就疯狂地痴迷于即将来临的名为“灰色风暴”的世界末日。它们原本和平的信条也扭曲成了自灭的狂信。出于对一个永远不会来临的末日的恐惧，尽管反复尝试强行灌溉，这星系中最古老的物种之一还是在数月之间枯萎殆尽了。
descriptions.en:
For all their efforts at secrecy, traces of the observers' clumsy meddling are everywhere on [big_rip_planet.GetName]...

Evidence suggests that the planet was inhabited by a psionically linked consciousness of plantoids that were in the midst of a religious awakening, when a mysterious alien race, referred to as the gatekeepers, descended upon them without warning. From that point on the plants became obsessed with the idea of an impending apocalyptic event called 'the Gray Tempest.' Their formerly peaceful religion soon spiraled into a suicide cult. Within a matter of months one of the galaxy's most ancient lifeforms had wilted away for fear of a doomsday that would never come, despite repeated attempts at forced rehydration.

descriptions.zh:
我们追踪[From.GetName]上散发的异常电磁辐射的来源，发现了一座地下碉堡，里面藏着一台足有一艘战列舰那么大的超级电脑。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]怀疑它可能已经在那存在了上千年，一直都在努力解决一个非常复杂的问题，而其本质仍不明确。

当试着与电脑互动时，他们发现那座似乎被废弃且不设防的设施，事实上受到一个保安人工智能的控制，其最高目的似乎就是将访客烧焦。在终于击败了人工智能之后，它向未知接收者发送了一条信息。
descriptions.en:
We have traced the unusual electromagnetic radiation emanating from [From.GetName] to a secret subterranean bunker hiding a mega-computer the size of a battleship.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] suspect that it may have been there for several thousand years, hard at work solving a single very complex problem, the nature of which still eludes us.

When attempting to interact with the computer they discovered that the facility, which had appeared both abandoned and unguarded, was in fact operated by a security AI, the highest purpose of which seems to be frying its visitors with extreme prejudice. When the AI was finally defeated, it broadcasted a message to an unknown recipient.

label.zh: 把超级电脑拆了当零件！

tooltips.zh: 一台花了上千年都没能解决一个问题的电脑，最好还是拿来造成船壳吧……
tooltips.en: A computer that has failed to solve a single problem in a thousand years will serve us better as a new ship hull...

label.zh: 用它来强化我们自己的科研……
label.en: Use it to boost our own research...

tooltips.zh: 这需要关闭维持设施的人工智能，并将导致电脑在可预见的未来崩溃。
tooltips.en: This requires that we keep the AI maintaining the facility offline and will cause the computer to break down within a foreseeable future.

label.zh: 让它继续那神秘的计算……
label.en: Let it continue its mysterious calculations...

tooltips.zh: 我们最好不要打扰它。不管那电脑在尝试解决什么问题，看起来都挺重要的……
tooltips.en: We had better not disturb it. Whatever problem the computer is trying to solve, it seems important...

descriptions.zh:
在对[From.GetName]周围的残骸场进行细致扫描后，我们发现了一颗气密胶囊，里面有一只计时无比精确的原子钟。

它的频率不确定性低到需要再花八亿七千九百万年才会增加一秒，而且正在朝一个四十二年零三天后的日期倒计时。胶囊里没有记载这个日期代表着什么，或者其主人是谁。不过似乎有人失去时间概念了……
descriptions.en:
A closer scan of the debris field around [From.GetName] has led to the discovery of an airtight capsule containing an atomic clock that measures time with unparalleled precision.

It has a frequency uncertainty so low that it will be another 879 million years before it gains a single second and it is counting down to a date 42 years and 3 days away. The capsule holds no clues as to what this date signifies or who the owners are. But it seems as though someone out there has lost track of the time...

tooltips.zh: 滴答，滴答……
tooltips.en: Tick-tock, tick-tock...

tooltips.zh: 胶囊里满是貌似无害的线路，任何一根都可能触发大规模毁灭性武器，摧毁整个星系！船员会将它们全都剪断！
tooltips.en: The capsule is full of innocent-looking wires, any one of which could be rigged to set off a weapon of mass destruction so potent that it would wipe out the entire galaxy! The crew will snip them all!!

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后反刍。

讽刺的是，舰船的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们对大量的物种进行了评估，从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面。他们评价最高的物种之一是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因其[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]多汁，而且性情暴躁。而我们则在排名底端得了中庸的评价，因为我们的肉嚼起来费劲，而且反抗无力。有些人还真喜欢与食物玩耍……
descriptions.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a mediocre placement at the bottom of the list thanks to the stringiness of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后吐了出来。

讽刺的是，舰船上的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们已经从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面对海量物种进行了评估。他们首选的是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因为[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]鲜美多汁且性情暴躁。我们在这份列表中排名很低，被归入了一种以星号圈起的特殊类别，因为我们根本不可食用并且毫无猎取的乐趣。有些人还真喜欢与食材玩耍……
descriptions.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a special category at the bottom of the list surrounded by asterisks, thanks to the utter inedibility of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

label.zh: 看来他们终于碰到对手了……
label.en: Looks like they finally met their match...

tooltips.zh: 已经与星系最美味的外星生物[delicious_aliens.GetName]成功建立起联络。
tooltips.en: Communications enabled with the [delicious_aliens.GetName], the galaxy's most delicious aliens.

label.zh: 不排复杂度排什么口感？真奇怪。
label.en: Rating by taste rather than complexity? How odd.

tooltips.zh: 已经与星系最美味的外星生物[delicious_aliens.GetName]成功建立起联络。
tooltips.en: Communications enabled with the [delicious_aliens.GetName], the galaxy's most delicious aliens.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的无数废弃舰船中，我们发现了一艘几乎完好无损的外星科研船。船上的记录揭示，它发生了严重设备故障，在虚空中漂流了142天后，其船员因缺乏营养而逝世。

我们在一张小床上发现了舰长遗骸，他手中握着一颗金属小方块，每一面都有不同的颜色，并分成九个大小相同的可旋转方块。科学专员[Root.Owner.GetScientist][cube_science_officer.GetName]相信，当旋转到正确的图案时，方块将会开启，并揭露隐藏的宝藏。
descriptions.en:
Among the husks of the derelict starships orbiting [From.GetName] we have discovered an almost intact alien research vessel. The ship's logs reveal that it suffered a critical hardware malfunction and was stuck in limbo for 142 days before the crew perished from malnutrition.

The body of the Captain was found on his cot clutching a small metal cube, each side a different color and split into nine equal rotatable squares. [Root.Owner.GetScientist] [cube_science_officer.GetName] is convinced that when rotated in the correct pattern the cube will open to reveal a hidden treasure.

options.script: name = distar.1055.b

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的船员们尝试了各种解码算法来对付那金属方块，但都没有任何反应。

“它是不是个密码？隐藏着宝贵物品的容器？”“如果这个方块没有意义，那什么才有意义？”科学专员[cube_science_officer.GetName]疲惫不堪的头脑中闪过了这些念头，最后[cube_science_officer.GetSheHe]终于使出了激光切割这一招，同时也不慎将[cube_science_officer.GetHerHis]的右[From.Owner.GetSpeciesHandName]切成了两半。方块里空空如也。
descriptions.en:
The crew on the [From.GetName] has subjected the metal cube to every code breaking algorithm known to us and it has responded with nothing but silence.

"Is it a cipher? A container for valuable items?" "If there is no meaning behind this cube, what then is the meaning of anything?" were some of the thoughts that scurried through the overworked mind of Science Officer [cube_science_officer.GetName] when [cube_science_officer.GetSheHe] finally brought out the laser and sliced first the cube, then [cube_science_officer.GetHerHis] right [From.Owner.GetSpeciesHandName] in half. The cube was empty.

tooltips.zh: [cube_science_officer.FromGetName]再也不会是原来的样子了。
tooltips.en: [cube_science_officer.GetName] will never be the same again.

descriptions.zh:
我们似乎遭遇了一种非原生无毛哺乳动物的繁殖地。我们观察到它们在晚间进行高级求偶活动，随后在各种酒精化学物质的作用下，于夜晚的沙滩上亲密地进行对偶结合。

可惜的是，它们意外地发现了我们的舰船，并惊慌失措地搭乘一艘商业舰船逃离了星球，留下了一地的垃圾。我们在其中发现了一本外星旅行指南书——《银河系漫游指南》，描述了许多我们未知的景观与现象。
descriptions.en:
We seem to have stumbled upon the breeding grounds of a non-native species of hairless mammalians. They could be observed engaging in advanced courtship in the evening followed by intimate pair-bonding on the sandy beaches at night, under the influence of a variety of intoxicating substances.

Regrettably an unintended sighting of our vessel spooked them and they have since vacated the planet in a commercial spacecraft, leaving behind them a trail of litter. Amongst it we have found a copy of the alien travel guide "A Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy," describing many sights and phenomena still unknown to us.

label.zh: 这本指南书将鼓舞我们！
label.en: This guide will serve as an inspiration to our people!

label.zh: 肮脏的外星人！人们必须知道它们是游手好闲并乱丢垃圾的不利因素。
label.en: Filthy aliens! Our people must know what a littering, loitering liability they are.

label.zh: 我们现在最好对此保密……
label.en: We had better put a lid on this discovery for now...

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName] 根本不是颗星球，而是个复杂的三维投影。它的中央是一个投影仪，生成一片能源场来逼真地模拟星球的实体与重力井，连我们的传感器都误以为它真的是颗星球，因此产生了异常的数据。我们只能猜测为何有人会特意在这个位置模拟一颗星球的存在。可惜的是，该投影仪在我们对它进行实验时被毁了。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] is not a planet at all, but a sophisticated 3D projection. At its center is a projector that generates an energy field simulating a physical body and gravity well so convincingly that our sensors mistook it for an actual planet, producing the anomalous data. We can only speculate as to why someone would go to the trouble of faking the presence of a planetary body at this location. Sadly the projector did not survive our experimentation.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的最新传感器读数显示恒星在有规律地悸动，但当[Root.GetName]的船员们抵达当地时，却没有发现支持这一数据的证据。尽管大多数船员都同意这是传感器故障引起的，[Root.GetLeaderName]却否认这一理论。[Root.GetLeaderName]宣称在别处发现了类似的悸动能源放射规律，并担心星系中的恒星正在遭遇怪事。[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHeCap]已安排了前往最近的受影响恒星的航线。
descriptions.en: The latest sensory readings from [From.GetName] showed the star pulsating regularly, but when the crew on [Root.GetName] arrived on site there was no evidence to support this data. While most of the crew are in agreement that the anomaly was caused by a sensory malfunction, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] discards this theory. [Root.GetLeaderName] claims to have discovered similar pulsating energy emission patterns elsewhere and now fears that something strange is happening to the galaxy's stars. They have charted the course to the nearest affected star.

label.en: We must get to the bottom of this...

descriptions.zh:
数日沉思后，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]出面承认了自己犯下的错误——遥远的恒星脉冲没有隐藏规律，也没有不祥的、形而上学的意图。正如[Root.GetLeaderName]所言：

§Y“偏执，如此而已。作为科学家，这不合逻辑、毫无计划，也着实不被欢迎。”§!

尽管看上去很尴尬，这篓子倒并非什么好处都没有；毕竟[Root.GetLeaderName]内心的斗争让其好好地审视了自己。
descriptions.en:
After a few days of heavy brooding, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is ready to admit that a mistake was made. There is no hidden pattern in faraway star pulses, no ominous, metaphysical intent. As [Root.GetLeaderName] described it:

§Y'It was paranoia, plain and simple. Illogical, erratic and quite unbecoming of a scientist.'§!

Embarrassing as it may have been, this blunder was not entirely without benefit, as [Root.GetLeaderName]'s inner conflict led to some valuable self-discovery.

descriptions.zh: 当船员们抵达[anomalous_star.GetName]时，他们确认传感器确实故障了。好消息是他们不仅大大低估了行星能量输出的初步估计，而且[From.GetLeaderName]似乎也从过去的错误中学到了教训。
descriptions.en: On the crew's arrival to [anomalous_star.GetName] they were able to confirm that their sensors were indeed malfunctioning. The good news is that not only were their initial estimates for the star's energy output grossly understated, [From.GetLeaderName] seems to have learned from past mistakes.

label.en: Failure is but a stepping stone to success.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的船员们不幸地发现，正如他们所料，我们从[anomalous_star.GetName]观测到的悸动规律确实是传感器故障……没错，是科学专员[crazy_science_officer.GetName]脑子里的那个传感器坏了。

科学专员的行为变得很不稳定。[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe]得了妄想症，自认为是世界的守护者，而恒星的悸动预示着世界末日即将到来。船员们认为[crazy_science_officer.GetHerselfHimself]在精神病发作时篡改了舰船的传感器数据。

该科学专员目前正在一个前往[Root.Capital.GetName]的医疗舱中，[crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe]将会在那里接受治疗。
descriptions.en:
The crew of the [From.GetName] has made an unfortunate discovery. Just as they suspected, the pulsating pattern we observed from [anomalous_star.GetName] was in fact due to a sensory malfunction... in Science Officer [crazy_science_officer.GetName]'s head.

The Science Officer's behavior has turned erratic. [crazy_science_officer.GetHeSheCap] suffers delusions about the stars broadcasting coded warnings about a coming apocalypse - and of having been appointed Protector of the Realm. The crew believes [crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe] [crazy_science_officer.GetHerselfHimself] manipulated the ship's sensory data during one such psychotic spell.

Science Officer [crazy_science_officer.GetName] is now in a medical pod headed back to [Root.Capital.GetName], where [crazy_science_officer.GetSheHe] will receive proper treatment.

label.zh: 感谢你的贡献，世界的守护者[crazy_science_officer.GetName]！
label.en: Thank you for your service, Protector of the Realm [crazy_science_officer.GetName]!

tooltips.en: §LTwinkle twinkle little star...§!

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一只巨型腹足动物的化石，它不符合任何先前遭遇的物种，并被困在一块围绕[From.GetName]旋转的巨大冰块中。它的眼睛怒视前方，触手扬起，鼻口扭曲成可怕的样子，好像被定格在一道无声的狂啸之中。该生物似乎没有明显的智慧特征。

尽管其面目狰狞，我们的科学家认为如果能将其驯化，该生物可以为我们所用。他们建议提取一些DNA以供克隆。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered the fossilized remains of a gargantuan gastropod, matching no previously encountered lifeform, trapped within a huge block of ice circling [From.GetName]. Its eyes glare fiercely ahead, tentacles reared and muzzle twisted into a gruesome grimace, as if locked in a silent shout. The creature displays no apparent signs of sapience.

Despite its eerie visage, our scientists believe that if domesticated the creature could make a valuable asset. They recommend extracting some of its DNA for cloning.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一只巨型腹足动物的化石，它不符合任何先前遭遇的物种，并被困在一块围绕[From.GetName]旋转的巨大冰块中。它的眼睛怒视前方，触手扬起，鼻口扭曲成可怕的样子，好像被定格在一道无声的狂啸之中。该生物似乎没有明显的智慧特征。

可惜以我们目前的科技实力，无法将其复生。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered the fossilized remains of a gargantuan gastropod, matching no previously encountered lifeform, trapped within a huge block of ice circling [From.GetName]. Its eyes glare fiercely ahead, tentacles reared and muzzle twisted into a gruesome grimace, as if locked in a silent shout. The creature displays no apparent signs of sapience.

Unfortunately we currently lack the technology to bring it back to life.

label.zh: 提取基因样本并加以储存，以备未来使用。
label.en: Extract and store a DNA sample for future use.

label.zh: 这块冻肉看起来可真新鲜啊！
label.en: A well refrigerated meal. How refreshing!

descriptions.zh: 我们利用化石的DNA成功地克隆出了一批巨型蛞蝓。它们于数周后发育成熟，重达20吨，并发展出了原始的智慧，会对简单的指令做出反应。尽管尚未表露出任何凶猛的本性，它们在被激怒时会分泌一种粘稠的毒液，而且它们的颜色也会随情绪而改变。因为它们相互沟通之时会发出兹兹声，科研团队将其命名为“阿兹詹虫”。
descriptions.en: We have successfully cloned a healthy population of gargantuan slugs from the fossilized DNA. They reached maturity within weeks, weighing up to 20 tons, and have developed a primitive level of sapience, responding to simple one-syllable commands. Though they have yet to show any violent tendencies, they produce a thick, toxic mucus when vexed, and their hue seems to shift with their mood. The research team has named them 'Azizians' for the hissing sounds with which they communicate among themselves.

label.zh: 它们会成为优秀的奴隶。

tooltips.zh: §Y400§!£pop£§H阿兹詹虫人口§!被添加至[This.GetName]
tooltips.en: §Y400§! £pop£ §HAzizian Pops§! are added to [This.GetName]

label.zh: 它们应该待在动物园里。
我们可以把它们收编进军团。
label.en: We could use them in the army.

tooltips.zh: 谁不想要一大群凶猛的蛞蝓来碾压其敌人呢？
tooltips.en: Who would not want an army of murderous slugs with which to crush their enemies?

label.zh: 简直令人毛骨悚然。立即把它们处理掉！
label.en: They are horrendous. Dispose of them NOW!
We have seen enough. Butcher them now.

descriptions.zh: 饲养在[Root.GetName]上动物园里的阿兹詹虫腹足动物逃了出来，并开始四处破坏！我们本以为它们已经发育成熟，可它们却在笼子里继续成长，体积犹如怪物一般巨大。它们横穿城市，像积木一样推倒建筑，在所经之处留下一道亮黄色的毒液。星球再也不会像过去那样了。
descriptions.en: The Azizian gastropods kept in the Zoo on [Root.GetName] have broken out and gone on a rampage! The creatures, who were believed to have reached full maturity, continued to grow in captivity and have since reached monstrous proportions. They tore through the city, knocking over buildings like game pieces, leaving in their wake a trail of bright yellow toxic mucus. The planet will never be the same again.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的阿兹詹虫劳工发展出了完整的智慧。我们本以为它们已经发育成熟时，其实仍在幼年期，而现在进入成年期的它们才完全展露了潜力。它们学会了我们的语言，并希望留在我们的文明里。
descriptions.en: The Azizian laborers on [Root.GetName] have developed full sapience. The creatures, who were believed to have already reached full maturity, were in fact still spawn and are only now, in adulthood, reaching their full potential. They have picked up our language and wish to remain here in our civilization.

options.script: name = distar.1083.b

descriptions.zh: 我们最近在克隆领域取得了巨大的技术突破，科学家们将取自冰层中的某个疑似灭绝的外星生物的基因再次拿了出来。现在我们终于可以让这神秘的有机生命体重新复活了。
descriptions.en: Following our recent breakthrough within the field of cloning, our scientists have brought the alien DNA extracted from a presumably extinct alien, found within an ice slab, out from storage. Restoring the mysterious organism to life has been a long-lasting dream for the department, now made possible through the miracle of science.

label.zh: 允许他们复活神秘的有机生命体。

label.en: They will do no such thing.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]地表上观察到的神秘图案，原来是巨型自动收割机在收割庄稼时留下的痕迹。我们的科学家猜测，这整颗星球曾经是某个强大的星际帝国的菜篮子。

土壤肥沃且气候宜人，使得[From.GetName]完美地适合耕作，而对星球植被的扫描结果显示，上面的每一种植物都可食用。磨损的收割机与成堆的腐烂蔬菜表明，已经多年未有人来收集这些收成了。
descriptions.en:
The mysterious patterns observed across [From.GetName]'s surface are trails made by huge automated harvesters that gather their crops by shredding the lush greenery. Our scientists speculate that the entire world once served as the breadbasket of a powerful space-borne nation.

The rich soil and advantageous climate make [From.GetName] perfect for agriculture and a scan of the planet's flora indicates that every single plant on it is edible. The worn-down state of the harvesters and droves of rotting vegetable flesh suggest it has been years since anyone last collected its yield.

label.zh: 我们不能让这些食物被浪费掉！
label.en: We cannot let good food go to waste!

options.script: name = distar.1090.a

label.en: We have no use for such a planet.

options.script: name = distar.1090.b

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]表面上蜿蜒的图案不见了，而原先覆盖着地表的绿色植被也魔法一般地消失了。连一草一木也没有剩下。但我们的科学家认为他们可能解开了谜底。

从大量节肢动物的排泄物与遗骸来判断，科学家们认为这颗星球曾短暂地接待了一群贪婪的星际昆虫，它们从一颗星球飞到另一颗星球，并横扫每颗星球的食物。
descriptions.en:
The sinuous patterns swirling across [From.GetName]'s surface are gone and so, as if through magic, is the lush vegetation that formerly covered the planet. Not a single leaf, straw or flower remains. But our scientists think they may have pieced together the puzzle.

The ample presence of droppings and carcasses of arthropoids have led them to believe that the planet briefly played host to a swarm of ravenous spaceborne insects that passes from world to world stripping entire planets of food.

label.zh: 但愿虫群永远不会找到我们的星球。
label.en: Let us hope the swarm never finds our worlds.

descriptions.zh: 我们在垃圾中找到了一颗原本可以居住的星球的碎片。破碎的方式与碎片上的焦痕表明，它受到了集束热能的冲击，直到它在压力下裂开为止。这使其矿物丰富的核心可以外泄，并固化成高品质矿物块。
descriptions.en: Among the debris we have discovered the shattered remains of a formerly habitable planet. The patterns of fragmentation and charring on the shards suggest it was blasted with concentrated beams of thermal energy until it cracked from the pressure. This allowed for the mineral-rich core to spill out and solidify into clumps of high-quality minerals.

descriptions.zh:
看来[From.GetName]经历过多次末日。表面扫描显示，这颗星球曾被某种我们未曾遭遇过的大规模武器测试狂轰滥炸过。

尽管外星人曾多次试图彻底毁灭这颗星球，但他们似乎仍未掌握这种科技。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]收集了一系列损坏的武器残骸，希望能够复原它们的武器。
descriptions.en:
It seems the apocalypse has come to [From.GetName] many times over. Surface scans reveal that the planet has been scorched, bombarded, seared and peppered in what is surely some of the most extensive weapon testing we have yet to encounter.

Though countless attempts have been made to obliterate the planet entirely, it appears the aliens had not yet developed the technology for it. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has collected an assortment of broken weapon remains in the hopes of recreating their designs.

options.script: name = distar.2005.b

descriptions.zh: 通过对[From.From.GetName]上找到的武器进行研究，我们学到了很多。回收的碎片来自一种定向能武器系统，发射高度集中的能源束，可在太空战中起到很好的效果。科学专员[science_leader.GetName]建议我们要么开发能够抵御激光的装甲，要么复制激光武器来装备自己。
descriptions.en: We have learned much from analyzing the remains of the weapons found on [From.From.From.GetName]. The recovered fragments were from a mounted directed-energy weapon system that emits a highly focused energy ray that can be used with great results in space warfare. Science Officer [science_leader.GetName] recommends we use our finds either by developing armor to counter the lasers or by recreating the weapons for ourselves.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的海洋几乎完全被一种精细的海藻网络所覆盖，它们以对称的方式摆动，而无视水的流向。其动作的复杂性与规律性表明，这些海藻的作用可能不仅仅是生存那么简单。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]猜测该网络可能其实是一种原始的生体电脑，而其摆动规律则是其界面。可惜我们目前无法解码其规律。
descriptions.en:
The oceans of [From.GetName] are almost completely covered in a fine network of algae that move in symmetrical patterns, independently of the water's shifting currents. The intricacy and regularity of its motion suggest the algae have been programmed with purpose beyond that of survival.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that the network may in fact be a primitive wetware computer and the movement patterns its interface. Regrettably we have no means of decoding the patterns at this time.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的表面上存在着许多单纯有机物质的浆团，我们的科学家认为这可能是生物自生的温床——无机物质天然形成有机物的过程，因[From.GetName]异常浓密的大气层而成为可能。

尽管星球提供了一个研究可能是生命早期起源的独特机会，但我们最好还是不要太过期待，因为如果生命真的会在[From.GetName]上自然出现的话，至少还需要好几百万年。
descriptions.en:
Nestled in sheltered pockets across [From.GetName]'s surface is a rich sludge of simple organic compounds that our researchers believe could be a hotbed for abiogenesis - the spontaneous formation of organic life from lifeless matter. [From.GetName] has an unusually thick atmosphere for a barren world, which could make it hospitable for simple lifeforms.

Although this presents a unique opportunity to study what could be the early stages of the origin of life, it would be best to set our expectations low, as it may still be millions of years before life evolves naturally on [From.GetName], if at all.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]表面的隐蔽区域内发现了富含小分子有机化合物的淤泥，我们的研究人员认为，这些淤泥可能是生命诞生的温床，可使无生命物质自发形成有机生命。毕竟[From.GetName]的大气对一个荒芜星球而言显得过于厚重了，这可能导致它成为简单生命体的乐园。

当然，这是我们不能容忍的。在生命自发产生之前，我们必须把这富含有机物的粪汤毁掉——即使生命诞生可能尚需数百万年！
descriptions.en:
Nestled in sheltered pockets across [From.GetName]'s surface is a rich sludge of simple organic compounds that our research drones believe could be a hotbed for abiogenesis - the spontaneous formation of organic life from lifeless matter. [From.GetName] has an unusually thick atmosphere for a barren world, which could make it hospitable for simple lifeforms.

Naturally, this is intolerable to us. We must snuff this cesspool of organic matter out before life has a chance to develop - even if that may lie millions of years in the future!

descriptions.zh:
[Root.From.GetName]一眼看上去似乎存在着多种多样的生命形态，在一个与我们相似的生态系统中共存，养分在其中通过光合作用，腐烂与掠食在食物链中循环。

但仔细观察后，船员们却发现，尽管[Root.From.GetName]上的生物当初独自成长，现在它们却神秘地像单一有机体一般行动。一个以凶猛的方式回应所有外界干扰的有机体。
descriptions.en:
At first glance [Root.From.GetName] seems to be inhabited by a diverse plethora of lifeforms. They co-existed in an ecosystem similar to our own, in which nutrients cycle the food chain through photosynthesis, decomposition and predation.

Upon closer inspection, however, the crew discovered that though all living things on [Root.From.GetName] may have started out as individuals, first they now, by mysterious design, operate as a single organism - one which responds to all outside interference with fierce and indiscriminate aggression.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.From.GetName]一眼看上去似乎存在着多种多样的生命形态，在一个与我们的家园[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]诞生蜂巢思维之前的样貌相似的生态系统中共存。

但仔细观察后，船员们却发现，尽管、上的生物当初独自成长，现在它们经过自然的演化，变得像单一有机体一般行动。一个原始的以凶猛的方式回应所有外界干扰的有机体。
descriptions.en:
At first glance [Root.From.GetName] seems to be inhabited by a diverse plethora of lifeforms, co-existing in an ecosystem likely not dissimilar to what our home of [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName] might have developed - in a time before, or without, our hive.

Upon closer inspection, our drones discovered that although the organisms developed as individuals first they now, through the natural course of evolution, operate as a single organism. A primitive organism that doesn't know any better than to respond to all outside interference with fierce and indiscriminate aggression.

descriptions.zh:
对[From.GetName]的外壳深度扫描确认了我们的猜想，[From.GetName]不是一颗普通的月亮，整个星体都是人造结构，由矿藏丰富的岩石作为原材料建造而成，被一个巨大的钢铁框架结构包裹着。

看起来它被创造出来以降低[artificial_moon_planet.GetName]的自转速度，让其白天更长，潮汐更高，使其更加宜居。但目前我们可以确认没有任何生物曾在其上殖民过。
descriptions.en:
Deeper scans of [From.GetName]'s crust confirm what the crew already suspected - [From.GetName] is no ordinary moon. The entire planetary body is an artificial construct, made out of exceptionally mineral rich rock, packed around a massive steel framework.

Likely it was created to slow the rotational speed of [artificial_moon_planet.GetName], making the days longer and tides higher, priming it for habitation. As far as we can tell nobody ever settled the planet.

descriptions.zh:
[time_loop_world.GetName]正在烧尽。星球被一面护盾笼罩，它捕捉[time_loop_world.GetStarName]的辐射，将其加热至很快无法生存的温度。

在这片炽热中，一个先进的微型有鳞爬行动物文明正在疯狂地忙碌着。某种非常重要的大事似乎正在进行。可是，当紧张状态到达巅峰时，时间突然停止了，接着伸展并扭曲，直到爬行动物文明不可思议地回到了开始。

它们似乎被困在了时空循环之中，一个绝望的快进循环，从它们文明的发源开始。在仅仅数小时之内，无数个世代在变更交替，对它们注定将在炽热之中死亡一事毫不知情。

但我们在护盾中发现了一道裂痕，可使我们改变它们的命运。
descriptions.en:
[time_loop_world.GetName] is burning up. The planet is enclosed in a shield that is capturing [time_loop_world.GetStarName]'s radiation, heating it to what will soon be uninhabitable temperatures.

In the scorching heat an advanced civilization of tiny squamate reptilians scurry about in frenzied activity. Some event of great magnitude seems to be in the works. Yet, as tension peaks, time stops without warning, then stretches and morphs until, impossibly, the reptilians are back where they started.

They appear to be locked in a time loop, a hopeless cycle of fast-forwarded repetition, starting at the birth of their civilization. In mere hours countless generations can be observed living out their lives, unaware they have been condemned to certain, crispy death.

But we have discovered a crack in the shield that could allow us to change their fate.

tooltips.zh: 将这些长鳞片的可怜虫囚禁于此一定有合理的原因。
tooltips.en: Someone locked the scaled critters up and probably for good reasons too.

label.zh: 它们的命运由自己决定。
label.en: Their fate is their own to decide.

descriptions.zh:
我们尽可能加强了围绕[time_loop_world.GetName]的护盾，而没有打扰其中的居民。对其大气层的详细调查结果表明，这些小蜥蜴们很可能会在一个世纪内被烤焦。

该星球提供了一个独特的研究机会，但如果我们希望研究这些蜥蜴以及它们被困其中的时空循环，那我们最好尽快开始。
descriptions.en:
We have reinforced the cracking shield around [time_loop_world.GetName] to the best of our abilities, without disturbing the world's inhabitants. Closer investigations of its atmosphere predict that the tiny lizards are likely to meet a fiery end within a century.

The planet provides a unique opportunity for research but if we intend to study the lizards and the time loop in which they are trapped it would be wise to begin soon.

descriptions.zh:
被困在[time_loop_world.GetName]的护盾后的蜥蜴型外星人毁于星球的迅速升温。看来环境的极端变化并无法打断困住它们的时空循环。

这颗原本非常忙碌的星球上现在已没有什么可研究的了。
descriptions.en:
The society of lizard-like aliens trapped behind the shield on [time_loop_world.GetName] have succumbed to the planet's rapid warming. It seems the extreme changes to the environment were not enough to break the time loop in which the lizards were stuck.

There is little left to research on this formerly so vibrant world.

label.en: Such is the way of the universe.

In mere hours countless generations can be observed living out their lives, unaware they have been condemned to a certain, crispy death. We could not save them if we tried. The shield is impenetrable.

options.script: name = FASCINATING

descriptions.zh:
好消息是我们打断了[time_loop_world.GetName]的时空循环。坏消息是星球上的居民没有活下来。

原来那时空循环，是由人造奇异场在护盾内扭曲时空造成的，并且当蜥蜴们的行为作出某种未知但非常特定的改变时，护盾将会关闭。我们的科学家认为这可能与蜥蜴们的侵略性倾向有关。

在偶然的巧合下，我们在循环的最后将其打破，此时这些蜥蜴们正在进行一场冷战，它们的小爪子正放在核武器的发射按钮上。在释放后的数秒内，蜥蜴们就在炽热的核爆中消失了。
descriptions.en:
The good news is we have broken the time loop on [time_loop_world.GetName]. The bad news is its inhabitants did not survive the ordeal.

The loop, which was caused by an artificial singularity field that curved space and time within the shield, was set to deactivate on an unknown but very specific change in the lizards' behavior. Our scientists believe it may have had something to do with their somewhat aggressive tendencies.

Through a stupefying coincidence we managed to break the loop at a moment when the lizards had their tiny paws on the nuclear launch trigger. Within seconds of their release the reptilians had disappeared in a fiery inferno of nuclear devastation.

在关闭力场后，蜥蜴们立即对我们作出了侵略性的反应。然后它们开始着手对付那护盾，在数小时内将它轰成了碎片。
descriptions.en:

The time loop, which was caused by an artificial singularity field that curved space and time within the shield, was set to deactivate on an unknown but very specific change in the lizards' behavior. Our scientists believe it may have had something to do with their penchant for violence.

Upon disabling the field the lizards reacted with immediate aggression to our presence. They then got to quick work on the shield, blasting it to bits within hours.

descriptions.en: The Lizards have broken free. Somehow they must have solved the time loop conundrum on their own and then managed to shatter the already cracking shield.

descriptions.zh:
一个管状外星实体已经进入了[Root.GetName]的轨道，而毫无预警或解释。它似乎不靠任何引擎或是推进器就能移动，完全无声地在虚空中滑行，其圆柱体不祥地旋转着。

尽管它没有表现出任何敌意，但也并未回应我们的呼叫。我们的军团顾问警告说，它可能会对下面的居民造成严重威胁，并恳求我们动手将它消灭。但我们的科学家则请求研究这一非凡的科技。
descriptions.en:
A tubular alien entity has entered orbit of [Root.GetName], with no warning or explanation. It appears to be moving without engines or thrusters, gliding in complete silence through the void of space, cylinders rotating ominously.

Though it has yet to display any signs of aggression, it refuses to acknowledge our hails. Our military advisors warn that it may pose a considerable threat to the inhabitants below and implore us to engage neutralization protocols. Our scientists, however, plead that we instead learn from this remarkable piece of technology.

label.en: The safety of our people must come first.

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们对神秘容器进行了大量研究，其来源仍是个谜。尽管它绝不是有机物，但也不完全是机械。它的主要任务似乎是收集，储存并编码数据。

它的表面上覆盖着成百上千道微小的刮痕，我们在其中发现了一种不属于这个星系的物质。
descriptions.en:
Despite extensive research the enigmatic cache and its origin are still shrouded in mystery. Though it is definitely not organic in nature, it is not entirely machine either. It appears to be preoccupied mainly with the gathering, storing and encoding of data.

Its surface is covered in hundreds of thousands of minuscule scratches and dents in which we have discovered traces of a compound that is alien to our galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 看起来神秘容器对[Root.GetName]的扫描已经结束，它现在开始寻找另一颗我们境内的行星进行扫描。
descriptions.en: It appears as though the Enigmatic Cache is now done with its scan of [Root.GetName] and is seeking another target planet within our borders.

descriptions.zh: 无论神秘容器来到[Root.GetName]的目的是什么，它已经完成了它的目标。正如同它来得诡异迅速一样，神秘容器现在又突然地离开了。
descriptions.en: Whatever the Enigmatic Cache's purpose here on [Root.GetName] may have been, it has come to an end. As abruptly as it arrived, the enigmatic cache is now leaving.

label.en: A relief for the citizens of [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 之前可能扫描了我方一颗星球而引起我们怀疑的神秘存在再次出现，而且正在进入[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道。它似乎正在尝试和我们进行通信。
descriptions.en: The mysterious tubular entity that we suspect previously scanned one of our planets has returned and is entering orbit of [Root.Capital.GetName]. It appears to be attempting to initiate communications.

descriptions.zh: 神秘容器的侧面冒出奇怪形状的光线，上面的轮子也以前所未有的速度飞转起来，各种齿轮开始发出焦躁的轰鸣声。听上去好像这东西随时会爆开一般。与此同时，我们的民众也在睡梦中开始不安地翻滚，头部也与容器的韵律进行着共振。他们的夜间休眠被科技奇迹的景象与复杂的各种计算打断了。
descriptions.en: The Enigmatic Cache's wheels whir with an unprecedented fervor as strange patterns of light morph along its sides, cogs and gears humming agitatedly. It sounds as if it could break any minute. Meanwhile our people stir restlessly in their slumber, heads resonating with the Cache's rhythmical drone, their night interrupted by visions of technological wonders and complex calculations.

descriptions.zh:
神秘容器的侧面冒出奇怪形状的光线，上面的轮子也以前所未有的速度飞转起来，各种齿轮开始发出焦躁的轰鸣声。听上去好像这东西随时会爆开一般。与此同时，我们的民众也在睡梦中开始不安地翻滚，头部也与容器的韵律进行着共振。他们的夜间休眠被科技奇迹的景象与复杂的各种计算打断了。

似乎大家健康状况尚可，仅有[ROOT.GetEyeNamePlural]偶尔会出现出体液外流的症状，但我们一些人口受到了愈发严重的乏力症状影响而降低了产出。
descriptions.en:
The Enigmatic Cache's wheels whir with an unprecedented fervor as strange patterns of light morph along its sides, cogs and gears humming agitatedly. It sounds as if it could break any minute. Meanwhile our people stir restlessly in their slumber, heads resonating with the Cache's rhythmical drone, their night interrupted by visions of technological wonders and complex calculations.

Aside from the occasional fluid leak from their [ROOT.GetEyeNamePlural], they appear to be in good health, but the production of some of our population is affected by their growing fatigue.

label.zh: 若是为了追求知识，无论何等代价都是值得的。

descriptions.zh:
经过长时间的不被打扰的、平静的催眠之后，巴铎尔43号似乎进入了一种疯狂的状态，轮子以飞快的速度旋转，向那些敢于休息的人投射出一连串荒诞的噩梦。

尽管许多人根本不愿休眠，但不幸的是，少数人似乎陷入了植物人状态，无法醒来。

我们的工程师认为，这个从一开始就严重受损的实体可能正在恶化。如果无人看管，我们的提升可能不会按计划进行。
descriptions.en:
After a long period of undisturbed, uneventful hypnopedia, BALDOR XXXXIII appears to have entered a frenzied state, wheels spinning at a furious rate, projecting rapid strings of absurdist nightmares to those who dare rest.

While many are reluctant to go to rest at all, an unfortunate few appear to have become trapped in a vegetative state from which they are unable to wake up.

Our engineers suggest the entity, which was badly damaged from the start, may be deteriorating. If left unattended our ascension may not go as planned.

descriptions.zh: 我们已中断了飞升进程，我们的民众也正在逐渐回复成原来的可靠模样。被称为巴铎尔43号的谜之外星存在已陷入了严重的迷乱状态。
descriptions.en: We have terminated the ascension process and our people are slowly returning to their good old dependable selves. The tubular alien entity known as BALDOR XXXXIII has left in a deeply discombobulated state.

label.zh: 这一定就是最好的结果了。
label.en: Surely it was for the best.

options.script: name = "distar.5069.a"

descriptions.zh: 我们的工程师成功令巴铎尔43号恢复了稳定，提升过程也照常进行，我们的民众虽然不大情愿，但还是回归了他们的日常睡眠规律。催眠学习法已经显示出了不俗的效果，很多民众对科学的兴趣都大大提升了。
descriptions.en: Our engineers have stabilized BALDOR XXXXIII, the uplifting process is back on track and our people have, somewhat reluctantly, returned to their regular sleeping patterns. The hypnopedia is already showing promising results, with our citizens taking an increased interest in science.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
催眠教学的最后一夜已经结束了，[Root.GetName]的公民即将迎来新的黎明。他们醒来后会看到一个完全不同的世界——一个充满科学奇迹和希望的世界。谁曾想宇宙是一个如此充满活力和迷人的地方？

我们初步的资料表明，我们确实发展出了一种增强的学习和科究能力，这都要归功于巴铎尔43号和拉沃西濒危外星生物保护协会。
descriptions.en:
The final night of hypnopedia has come to an end and a new day dawns for the citizens of [Root.GetName], who are just now opening their minds to a very different world - a world full of scientific wonder and promise. Who knew the universe was such a vibrant, fascinating place?

 Our initial readings indicate that we have indeed developed an enhanced capability for learning and scientific research thanks to BALDOR XXXXIII and the Lavosian Endangered Xeno Preservation Grant.

descriptions.zh:
催眠教学的最后一夜已经结束了，[Root.GetName]的公民即将迎来新的黎明，他们醒来后会看到一个全新的世界——一个充满可能性……和痛苦的世界。谁曾想宇宙原来是一个如此枯燥乏味的地方，不存在任何意义与目的？

尽管可能还需要一段时间，人们才会适应拥有高于平均水平的智力所带来的诸多苦难，但总的来说，这个项目可以被认为是成功的。我们初步的资料表明，我们已经发展出了一种强化的学习和科研能力。
descriptions.en:
The final night of hypnopedia has come to an end and a new day dawns for the citizens of [Root.GetName], who are just now opening their minds to a very different world - a world of possibility...and pain. Who knew the universe was such a drab and dreary place, devoid of all meaning and purpose?

Though it may be a while before the population adjusts to the many tribulations of having an above-average intelligence, overall the project can be considered a success. Our initial readings indicate that we have developed an enhanced capability for learning and scientific research.

descriptions.zh:
由于巴铎尔43号的状况快速恶化，尽管飞升过程已经完成，我们却没有获得完全的提升。虽然大部分人口都遭受着强烈的噩梦困扰，催眠学习法还是有所成效，他们在科学研究与学习中展现了超乎寻常的效率。对于陷入植物状态的不幸民众，情况就要糟糕一些了……虽然大部分最终都恢复了意识，但他们的理智与思维似乎在巨大压力下崩溃了。

虽说不是完全的飞升，但好歹……也算有所收获吧。
descriptions.en:
The ascension process is complete, yet we have not ascended, due to the rapidly deteriorating state of BALDOR XXXXIII. Though the majority of our population still suffers from intense night terrors, the hypnopedia appears to have yielded some good results as they now show an unprecedented proficiency for scientific research and learning. For the unlucky citizens who were trapped in a vegetative state, the situation is more dire... Though most have regained consciousness, their minds seem to have caved under the pressure.

It may not be a full ascension, but at least it is...something.

descriptions.zh: 在[cache_killers.GetSpeciesName]对巴铎尔43号发动突然袭击后，巴铎尔43号已不能维持其物质实体，我们人民的飞升进程也随之终止。能确认的是管状外星实体现在的状况十分糟糕。由于其在对我们进行提升的过程中特别脆弱，在攻击中它的核心部位遭受严重损害。当它消逝时，它传递了一个信息：“我是巴铎尔4……”
descriptions.en: Following an unprovoked assault from the [cache_killers.GetSpeciesName], BALDOR XXXXIII has dematerialized and the ascension of our people has been terminated. We believe the tubular alien entity, which was already in poor condition, was especially vulnerable during the ascension and suffered significant damage to its core functions in the attack. As it departed it transmitted the message "I am BALDOR XXX..."

options.script: name = distar.5070.a

descriptions.zh: 由于[From.GetSpeciesName]入侵势力，我们在混乱的交火中失去了[FromFromFrom.GetName]，巴铎尔43号严重受损，已不能维持其物质实体，我们人民的飞升进程也随之终止。能确认的是管状外星实体现在的状况十分糟糕，它被敌人的炮火波及，核心部位遭受严重损害。在它消逝时，它发出了最后的求救信号：“我是巴铎尔4……”
descriptions.en: In the tumultuous aftermath of the loss of [FromFromFrom.GetName] to [From.GetSpeciesName] invading forces, BALDOR XXXXIII has dematerialized and the ascension of our people has been terminated. We believe the tubular alien entity, which was already in poor condition, accidentally came under enemy fire and suffered significant damage to its core functions. As it departed it sent out a final distress message; "I am BALDOR XXX."

options.script: name = distar.5078.a

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]轨道上发现的那艘全副武装的舰船是一艘被遗弃的军用舰船，名字叫“纳弗瑞的骄傲”。它的舰体十分轻盈、擅长闪避攻击，说明它是用来执行长途侦查任务的，但现在它被改装为了一个远程匿踪炸弹。从舰船的通讯记录中可知此船在袭击西万实验室的路上被某个叛军游击队截了下来，据说那个实验室中保存的威力强大的武器可以帮助游击队赢得战争胜利。我们从舰船的导航驱动器中找出了西万实验室的准确位置。
descriptions.en:
The armed vessel discovered in orbit of [From.GetName] is an abandoned military spacecraft called Nefri's Pride. Its light frame and evasion hardware suggest it was built for long-distance patrol missions, but it has since been retrofitted into a long-range stealth bomber.

Records of the ship's comms reveal it was hijacked by a rebel guerilla on its way to perform a strike against a secret complex called the Xvan labs, said to hold a weapon so powerful it could win them the war, when they were shot down. We have extracted the ship's destination from its navigational drive.

label.zh: 派一队科研考察队前往实验室。
label.en: Send a science crew to the lab.

label.zh: 我们并不需要这种武器。
label.en: We have no need for such a weapon.

owner = { add_resource = { influence = 50 } }

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家们从西万实验室安全归来并带回了实验室安保摄像头中的视频记录，视频中记录了如下场景：实验室科学家们被游击队士兵捆绑起来、游击队士兵试图打开武器箱，但发现里面空空如也。

几分钟后，叛军士兵们突然痛苦的倒地，他们身体上出现黑色斑点，然后灰色不明物质从他们体内钻出。

那些灰色物质不断膨胀，并围绕着他们旋转，其中一名实验室科学家启动了紧急系统，房间的洒水器开始喷水，然后电流经由洒水器让房间内所有的生物统统触电，然后视频记录就终止了。我们的科研队经过确认，发现武器箱确实是空的。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists have returned from the Xvan labs unscathed with footage collected from the facility's security cameras. It shows lab scientists bound and gagged as guerilla soldiers pry open the weapon strongbox. But to their dismay, the box is empty.

Only minutes later the rebels can be seen writhing on the floor in intense agony, dark patches swelling across their bodies, then their skin rips and a gray unidentifiable matter spills out.

The matter continues to expand, swirling hypnotically around them, until one of the scientists activates the emergency system. Sprinklers douse the room in liquid and an electrical surge passes through it executing all living things. Here the footage ends. Our crew can confirm that the strong box was indeed empty.

tooltips.zh: 我们对西万研究室的考察让我们的工程学研究技术取得了进一步发展。
tooltips.en: Our excursion into the Xvan labs has progressed our engineering research.

descriptions.zh: 位于[From.GetName]轨道上的被毁的军用舰船残骸中发出了某种信号，该信号来自某个觊觎我们文明长达数千年之久的外星势力，名为苏金帝国，他们企图使用某种干扰光束来劫持传送门网络，但在中途受到袭击导致舰船被毁。尽管光束已经启动并已经在传送门安保系统中调整完毕，但光束却在袭击中被破坏了，我们的科学家也许能修好它。
descriptions.en: The signal originates from a gathering of destroyed military vessels in orbit around [From.GetName]. It seems a foreign alien power predating our civilization by many thousand years, called the Sujin Empire, was attempting to hijack the gateway network using some kind of interference beam, when they were rudely interrupted. Though the beam is active and calibrated on the gateway's security network, it has been damaged in the assault. Perhaps our scientists could mend it.

label.en: It is certainly worth a try.

options.script: name = distar.2045.b

descriptions.zh: 虽然我们的科学家无法彻底搞清楚传送门的安保系统，但我们还是对传送门系统的工作原理有了一些深入了解。苏金帝国对传送门已经痴迷了数百年了，他们为了突破传送门的安保系统而尽最大努力收集了一切相关信息。
descriptions.en: Though our scientists were unable to pierce the gateway's security system, we have gained some very valuable insight into how the network functions. The Sujin empire had been obsessed with the gateways for centuries, and gathered all data they could find in an effort to break through.

descriptions.zh:
与我们的预期相符，小行星[From.GetName]内部含有大量金属，且藏有某种机械装置。

目前收集的数据清楚地表明其部件内贮藏着大量能源，但其存在的目的目前依旧未知。
descriptions.en:
As suspected, the asteroid [From.GetName] holds within it a great mass of metal and does indeed hide some manner of machinery.

The gathered data clearly shows that its constituent parts contain great quantities of stored energy, but its purpose remains unknown.

tooltips.zh: 轻缓地对小行星进行开凿。
tooltips.en: Gently excavate the asteroid.

tooltips.zh: 派出钻探无人机取回一份样本。
tooltips.en: Dispatch a drill probe to retrieve a sample.

descriptions.zh:
小心行事果然是明智之举。[trojan_asteroid.GetName]内部寄藏着大量采矿无人机，且均设置为无差别攻击模式。

万幸的是，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]提早发现了这一情况，并干扰了无人机传感器，为我们关闭无人机争取了足够的时间。

无人机的核心十分老旧，但还储存着大量能源供其吸取使用。
descriptions.en:
Caution proved well in order. Hidden inside [trojan_asteroid.GetName] was a host of old mining drones programmed to attack on sight.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] fortunately detected this early and was able to jam the drones' sensors long enough to disable them.

The drones' cores are old indeed, but retain vast amounts of energy for siphoning.

descriptions.zh:
强行勘探[Root.GetName]酿成了苦果。在小行星内部隐藏着大量老旧的采矿无人机，且均设置为无差别攻击模式。

无人机检测到了[Root.GetName]的存在并开始骚动。

如果[Root.GetName]反应迅速，也许还有时间做出规避动作。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName]'s forceful probing proved unfortunate. Within the asteroid was hidden a host of old mining drones, programmed to attack on sight.

The drones have picked up on the [Root.GetName]'s presence and are beginning to stir.

There may still be time for an evasive maneuver, if [Root.GetName] acts quickly.

descriptions.zh:
关于小行星[trojan_asteroid.GetName]到达[Root.Capital.GetName]网络一事传来新消息。科学研究界对其抱有极大好奇心，正在探究为何其中会包含大量无人机。

它们是要守卫什么东西吗？
descriptions.en:
News of the events relating to asteroid [trojan_asteroid.GetName] have reached the networks of [Root.Capital.GetName]. The scientific community has reacted with curiosity, posing questions as to why the drones were originally placed inside the asteroid.

Were they guarding something?

descriptions.zh:
正如[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上科学研究界假设，小行星[trojan_asteroid.GetName]中隐藏的无人机确实是有意隐藏着什么。

全赖[Root.GetName]船员的智勇努力，我们从小行星中心发掘出了之前被无人机的出现所遮蔽的大量矿产。
descriptions.en:
As the science community on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] hypothesized, the drones found in asteroid [trojan_asteroid.GetName] were indeed hiding something.

The valiant efforts of the [Root.GetName]'s crew have unearthed rich mineral deposits in the asteroid's core, previously obscured by the drones' presence.

descriptions.zh:
[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]上令人惊奇的生命迹象现已查明，是一种生存力极强的小型有机体。[Root.GetName]上的船员不知该如何对其进行分类，但其几乎不靠任何食物就能生存的能力实在令人叹为观止。考虑到该星球的年龄，这种有机体与其有毒环境可能已经斗争了几千年之久，不过这也只是我们根据现况的猜测而已。

科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]请求对该未知有机体进行采样，以便进行研究。
descriptions.en:
The surprising life readings from [impossible_organism_planet.GetName] have been attributed to a small organism of exceeding tenacity. The [Root.GetName]'s crew is unsure how to classify the lifeform, but its ability to survive, seemingly without any sustenance, is truly astonishing. Considering the planet's age, it is not impossible that the organism has been fighting its habitat's toxicity for millennia, though this is an educated guess at best.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has requested permission to retrieve samples of the unknown organism, so that it may be studied.

tooltips.zh:
向[From.GetName]添加§Y不可能的有机体§!修正：
£society£§G+3§!
tooltips.en:
Adds the §YImpossible Organism§! modifier to [From.GetName]:
£society£  §G+3§!

descriptions.zh:
对于神秘生命体的研究进展十分顺利。科学界均对其成长潜能十分震惊。它已成长为肉眼可见的形态，并会对外界刺激做出反应。目前观察，它似乎还具有从无论有机无机的任何物质中吸收能源和营养的能力。

然而，其基因，细胞与生化方面的各个过程我们目前都无法理解。
descriptions.en:
Studies of the mysterious lifeform are progressing well. The scientific community is amazed by its potential for growth. It is already visible to the naked eye and responds to stimuli, and appears able to absorb energy and nutrition from nearly anything, organic or not.

Alas, its genetic, cellular, and biochemical processes remain beyond our understanding.

label.zh: 我们应该继续对它进行研究。
label.en: We should continue to study it.
Disgusting! Poke it with a stick...

label.zh: 这外星人实在太危险了。

tooltips.zh: 将这生物射入外太空。
tooltips.en: Shoot the lifeform into deep space.

descriptions.zh:
经过最近的突破性发现，这种奇怪的生命体的面纱正在逐渐揭开！[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界正为此欢欣鼓舞。

这种生命体被定性为真菌类生物——这也在某种程度上解释了其能够靠吸收分子获取养分的特性。它的体积已有了显著的增大，目前已和新生[Root.GetSpeciesName]一般大小，并展现出了相当的智能与求知欲。谢天谢地，它目前尚未表现出任何敌意与攻击倾向。

科学家认为，下一步行动应着眼于与其尝试进行沟通。
descriptions.en:
After recent breakthroughs, the strange lifeform is no longer a complete mystery! The scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] are abuzz with the news.

The organism has been classified as a fungoid - partly explaining its ability to absorb molecules for nutrition. It has grown immensely, now the size of a newborn [Root.GetSpeciesName], and appears both inquisitive and intelligent. Thankfully, it has thus far shown no signs of aggression.

The scientists believe the next step to be attempts at communication, though it may be months before any progress is made on this front.

tooltips.zh:
继续研究真菌类生物。

可能要花上几个月才会有进展。
tooltips.en:
Continue studying the fungoid.

It may take months before there is any progress to report.

label.zh: 这个闹剧必须到此为止。。将样本封入真空所。
label.en: This has gone far enough.. Airlock the specimen.

tooltips.zh: 将这真菌类生物射入深空。
tooltips.en: Shoot the fungoid into deep space.

titles.zh: 不可能的真菌：第一个字

descriptions.zh:
小型真菌最近开始说话了！

它说出的第一个字是一个喉音：“尼瓦拉克”。虽然发音并不是十分连贯，但它却不厌其烦地重复着这个字眼。因此，科学家们自豪地将这个真菌生物命名为§Y尼瓦拉克§!。在这之后，其语言飞速发展，现已可成功表达全部七种最基本的情感——而且这种表达均是由其自身体验到这些情感所致。它还可以按时自我繁殖——方式为孢子扩散——照这个速度下去，很快实验室就要装不下这些真菌了。

截至目前，尼瓦拉克尚未表现出任何敌意和侵略性倾向。
descriptions.en:
The small fungoid has recently begun to vocalize!

Its first words were a guttural "nivlac." Incoherent, but ardently repeated. And so the scientists have proudly named the fungoid §YNivlac§!. Since then its language has developed at a spectacular rate and it's now able to successfully convey the seven primary emotions - and does so often to its own spawn. It reproduces - by spreading its spores - as a matter of routine, and the laboratory will soon be insufficient to house the fungoids.

The Nivlac still has not shown any signs of aggression.

label.zh: 太棒了。每个[Root.GetSpeciesName]都该备上一个！

tooltips.zh: 以£pop£§H尼瓦拉克人口§!填满[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]上的空闲住宅。
tooltips.en: Fill empty [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName] homes with £pop£ §HNivlac Pops§!.

label.zh: 好极了。[Root.GetAdj]社会一定可以好好利用它的。

tooltips.zh: 以£pop£§H尼瓦拉克人口§!填满[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]上的空闲住宅。
tooltips.en: Fill empty [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName] homes with £pop£ §HNivlac Pops§!.

label.zh: 真是宝贵的有机体啊。我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]要好好照料他们才行。
label.en: Precious organics. We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] shall care for them.

tooltips.zh: 以£pop£§H尼瓦拉克人口§!填满[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]上的空闲住宅。
tooltips.en: Fill empty [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName] homes with £pop£ §HNivlac Pops§!.

label.zh: 好极了，那就让他们同化融入我们的社会吧。

tooltips.zh: 在[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]上将产生最多§Y500§!£pop£§H尼瓦拉克人口§!。
tooltips.en: Up to §Y500§! £pop£ §HNivlac Pops§! will be spawned on [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName].

label.zh: 我们没有足够的空间了。把他们一把火烧了，就这样吧。
label.en: We have no room. Torch them and be done with it.

tooltips.zh: 摧毁这群真菌生物。
tooltips.en: Destroy the fungoids.

label.zh: 他们应该拥有属于自己的家园。
label.en: They should have a home of their own.

tooltips.zh:
我们的科学家将把实验室内的尼瓦拉克安置到专属于他们的合适行星上。

估计需要一段时间才会有新的进展。
tooltips.en:
Our scientists will relocate the Nivlacs from the laboratory to a suitable planet of their own.

It will be some time before we can expect an update.

titles.zh: 不可能的有机体：尼瓦拉克

descriptions.zh:
之前在[impossible_organism_planet.GetName]发现，并被我们以太过危险为由射入深空的外星生物，似乎在不久后于[nivlac_planet.GetName]成功着陆了。

它不仅在冲击中存活下来，还在这个新星球上建立了新的家园。它繁衍生息，创造出了可观的人口，并已成功跻身宇宙航行物种行列。

他们自称为尼瓦拉克。不幸的是，他们似乎还清楚地记得我们对他们死活置之不顾的事。
descriptions.en:
The alien lifeform once discovered on the toxic planet [impossible_organism_planet.GetName], and later fired into deep space after being deemed too dangerous, appears to have made planetfall on [nivlac_planet.GetName] some time thereafter.

It not only survived the impact, but has since managed to make a home of its new planet. It has prospered, grown, and subdivided into a small population, to the point of becoming a spacefaring species in and of itself.

They call themselves Nivlac, and unfortunately appear to recall our earlier disregard for their survival.

options.script: name = OOPS

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家荣幸地通知我们，尼瓦拉克安置到合适行星上的计划大获成功。

自从年轻的真菌类生物登上[nivlac_planet.GetName]后，爆炸性生长的势头也得以延续。它已成功聚集了一个小型群落，最近甚至还研究出了超光速科技——毫无疑问，这是得益于我们留下的科技。

我们会继续对它们的发展保持密切观察。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists are pleased to report that the Nivlac's relocation to a suitable planet was a great success.

Since the young fungoid's arrival at [nivlac_planet.GetName], it is apparent that its explosive growth has continued. It has established itself as a small people, and recently even developed FTL technology - undoubtedly aided by the technology we left behind.

We shall eagerly continue to watch their development.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
真菌生物尼瓦拉克进入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会的整合行动正在进行中。

尼瓦拉克与[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的关系目前十分融洽，且我们的物种似乎对与对方物种长久相处十分看好。
descriptions.en:
The integration of the fungoid Nivlac into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is underway.

The interactions between Nivlacs and [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] continue to be positive, and our species appear to be headed down a promising road together.

descriptions.zh:
将尼瓦拉克真菌生命体融入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会的进程正在如火如荼地进行中。

虽然尼瓦拉克对这一过程并不十分情愿，但他们的意识终将升华成为[Root.GetAdj]的一部分。
descriptions.en:
The assimilation of the fungoid Nivlac into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is underway.

While the Nivlac are resistant toward the process, their consciousnesses will eventually be sublimated into the [Root.GetAdj] whole.

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
custom_tooltip = distar.3017.a.tooltip

tooltips.zh: £pop£§H尼瓦拉克人口§!已添加至[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]。
tooltips.en: £pop£ §HNivlac Pops§! have been added to [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName].

tooltips.zh: £pop£§H尼瓦拉克人口§!已添加至[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]。
tooltips.en: £pop£ §HNivlac Pops§! have been added to [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName].

tooltips.zh: £pop£§H尼瓦拉克人口§!正在[nivlac_joint_planet.GetName]上新建的居所中极尽享受之能事。
tooltips.en: £pop£ §HNivlac Pops§! are being pampered in freshly-built sanctuaries on [nivlac_joint_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的坠毁残骸属于一名被困的科学家——[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]——其自称属于一个尚不为我们所知的物种，[stranded_scientist_species.GetName]。

不知怎么，她竟从残骸中联系到了驻扎于[Root.GetName]上的科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]，并要求我们进行救援。她解释称自己的坠毁是由于导航传感器失灵，并表示她已有数年未能离开这颗小行星了。

她声称自己具备人所不及的科学知识，是相当有用的资产。她说，自己能在这里活上这么久正是自己能力的明证。
descriptions.en:
The wreckage on the asteroid [From.GetName] is the remains of a vessel belonging to a now-stranded scientist - [stranded_scientist_leader.GetName] - identifying herself as belonging to the hitherto-unknown [stranded_scientist_species.GetName] species.

From amidst the wreckage she somehow managed to contact [Root.GetLeaderName], the Science Officer stationed aboard the [Root.GetName], and is requesting to be rescued. She explains that her collision was due to malfunctioning navigational sensors, and that she has been unable to leave the asteroid for several years.

She claims her scientific knowledge to be without equal, and that she would be a valuable asset. She points to her survival as proof of that.

label.zh: 她也许会加入我们的事业。

tooltips.zh: §Y[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]§!，一位6级£scientist£ 科学官，加入[Root.Owner.GetName]，并将分享其所掌握的科技知识。
tooltips.en: §Y[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]§!, a Level 6 £scientist£ Scientist, joins the [Root.Owner.GetName] and will share her technological knowledge.

tooltips.zh: 我们已任由[stranded_scientist_leader.GetName]自生自灭。
tooltips.en: [stranded_scientist_leader.GetName] is left to her fate.

descriptions.zh: 最近新加入的科学家[stranded_scientist_leader_clone.GetName]正在有效利用其科技知识。她向我们分享的知识令我们的物理学研究达到了全新高度。
descriptions.en: The recent scientist addition [stranded_scientist_leader_clone.GetName] has put her knowledge of technology to good use. Her shared insights have pushed our physics research to new heights.

tooltips.zh: 我们对£physics£ §Y科技§!的研究取得了更深的进展。
tooltips.en: Our research into £physics£ §YTechnologies§! is furthered.

descriptions.zh:
通过进一步观察[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]我们发现，其表面的房屋状结构是一种软体动物的家园。这些房屋都处于十分原始的状态，由土壤混合类似分辨的分泌物建造而成。

这种软体动物具有半智能和有限的智力。除生存之外，其社会与生活主要以发掘矿物为主。发掘出的矿物则会进行展示，提升发掘者的社会地位。

然而，他们探测矿物位置的方式目前尚不明确，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]被他们探知大量矿藏的能力深深震撼。

虽然这些软体动物的科学技术与几乎全部其他方面均比我们落后许多，但却可能对我们的采矿能力造成极大的帮助。
descriptions.en:
A closer look at [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] has shown that its hut-like structures are home to a molluscoid species. The huts are crude shelters, built out of soil and quasi-fecal excretions.

The molluscoids appear semi-sapient with limited intelligence. Besides survival, their society and lives revolve around unearthing minerals which are then put on display, seemingly to raise the social standing of the finder.

Their means of locating these minerals remain unclear, however, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is baffled by their ability to locate large deposits of minerals.

Though technologically inferior, studying these molluscoids may well further our mining capabilities.

label.zh: 有点意思。对他们再进行更深的研究。

descriptions.zh:
[molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName]上居住的软体生物会使用一种奇异的方式来寻找他们想要的矿物。

目前看来，他们可从皮肤排出一种分泌物，渗入土壤并进一步下探。不知为何，这种分泌物具有感应能力，只要连接不断，即可为这种软体动物提供信息。以这种办法，他们就可以对超大规模的地下结构进行测绘，并探明被分泌物触碰到的矿藏。

若能将这些软体动物整合入我们的社会，或单纯使用这种技术来提升我们的生产工序，应该会令我们的矿物生产设施大受裨益。
descriptions.en:
The molluscoids inhabiting [molluscoid_miners_planet.GetName] employ a strange method to locate their coveted minerals.

Apparently their skin naturally produces gelatinous secretions which seep into the porous soil, trickling ever downward while remaining attached to their skin as long strings. These secretions effectively sample the soil, feeding back sensory information to the molluscoid individual as long as the slimy strands remain unbroken. In this manner, they are able to map out surprisingly large parts of the underground terrain and map out mineral veins.

If we were to integrate the molluscoids into our society, or simply advance our production processes with this knowledge, it is likely our mining enterprises would benefit greatly.

label.zh: 别管什么矿物了，收获它们的基因。
label.en: Never mind the minerals, harvest the DNA.

trigger = {		# Prevents Genocidal Empires from integrating molluscs
			has_origin = origin_evolutionary_predators
			values_others = no
		}

label.zh: 好。我们就对这些知识加以利用吧。
label.en: Yes, we will use this knowledge.

descriptions.zh:
软体类物种已成功整合入[Root.Owner.GetAdj]社会。

为了促进整合进程，我们将他们命名为§Y[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]§!。[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]性情温顺，工作勤奋，目前已观察到我们对矿物产量有了显著提升。
descriptions.en:
The integration of the molluscoids into [Root.Owner.GetAdj] society is complete.

To facilitate the integration, they have been given the name §Y[molluscoid_miners_species.GetName]§!. The [molluscoid_miners_species.GetName] are obedient and hardworking, and a marked increase in our mineral production has already been observed.

descriptions.zh:
一套能够快速勘测地下地形并探明其包含的矿藏的系统现已投入使用。

通过利用无法穿透矿物质的特定恒星射线与宇宙射线，我们可以收集关于天体内部矿藏数量的数据。这如同为天体直接拍一张X光片，无论是小行星或行星的一部分都可以实现精准探测。

我们对科学家称其为矿物测绘，这一技术应当可以大大提高我们的采矿效率。
descriptions.en:
A system enabling us to quickly chart underground terrain and the minerals it contains has been implemented.

By analyzing planetary reflection of particular solar and cosmic rays, which are unable to penetrate most minerals, we can gather data on the crust's mineral composition. This makes it possible to essentially x-ray a target body, be it an asteroid or part of a planet.

Our scientists have dubbed it Mineral Mapping, and it should greatly improve our mineral production.

descriptions.zh:
进一步扫描表明机械仍在运转，而其目的至今仍然毫无头绪。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]表示自己从未见过这样的东西。其中有些材料似乎有些眼熟，但绝大部分都是见所未见的外星产物，其部件与结构也是一样。

机器似乎具备一个控制台，台上有一样十分显眼的物品：一柄由不明材料制成的大而弯曲的拉杆。
descriptions.en:
Further scans suggest the machine is still operational, though its purpose remains entirely unclear.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has never seen anything like it. Some of its materials look familiar, but most are strange and utterly alien as the design of its components.

The machine has what appears to be a console, with one item in particular standing out: a large crooked lever of unknown material.

tooltips.zh: 科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]拉下了奇怪的拉杆。
tooltips.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] pulls the strange lever.

tooltips.zh: 机器已经拆解，并对部件进行了回收。
tooltips.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.

descriptions.zh:
曲柄被拉动之后发生了什么还不清楚。

那个控制台不停闪烁，并发出巨大的震动。一股巨大的能量波直冲云霄，进入宇宙深处。附近的科学家都感到一股能量之风猛然吹过，但并没有任何感官上的直接证据。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]并不清楚发生了什么。外星机器随后立刻沉寂了下来，再也没有任何能量反应。
descriptions.en:
It is unclear what happened when the machine's lever was pulled.

Its console flickered, powerful vibrations could be felt, and then a wave of energy surged from the machine, expanding outwards into deep space. The scientists close by felt this wave push past them, but experienced no other sensory evidence of its passing.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is unsure what to make of it. The machine itself returned to its inactive state immediately thereafter, and no longer returns any energy readings.

label.zh: 真是古怪。快拆开来看看吧。
label.en: How strange. Now take it apart.

tooltips.zh: 机器已经拆解，并对部件进行了回收。
tooltips.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.

label.zh: 有点意思。快研究一下这机器。

descriptions.zh:
在我们的科学家拉下拉杆后，机器迸出巨大的能量冲击，在虚空形成中扭曲和涟漪，在§Y[system_one.GetName]§! 中撕出一个虫洞。

在剩余能量的消散后，虫洞及其附近区域稳定下来，现在看起来足够稳定，可以安全通过。至于在另一边等待我们的是什么，我们的科学家们并不那么确定。

机器本身重归沉寂，不再发出任何异常读数。
descriptions.en:
As our scientists pulled the lever the machine emitted a huge blast of energy that multiplied in shockwaves, twisting and rippling through the void, tearing open a wormhole in §Y[system_one.GetName]§!.

After the residuous energy diffused the wormhole and the immediate area around it settled and now appear to be stable enough for safe passage. As for what awaits us on the other side our scientists are not so sure.

The machine itself has since returned to its inactive state and no longer gives off any anomalous readings.

label.zh: 真是古怪。快拆开来看看吧。
label.en: How strange. Now take it apart.

tooltips.zh: 机器已经拆解，并对部件进行了回收。
tooltips.en: The machine is disassembled and its parts salvaged.
