descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[wormhole_system.GetName]§!星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"§H虫洞§!"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
descriptions.en:
We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the §H[wormhole_system.GetName]§! system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "§Hwormhole§!" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculate, may provide a conduit through subspace to another wormhole located somewhere else in our galaxy.

Depending on where the second wormhole is located, this could potentially allow ships to travel from one end of the galaxy to the other in a matter of days. Unfortunately, this wormhole, like the vast majority of its kind, is inherently unstable. Any vessels foolish enough to pass through it would be ripped apart in seconds.

label.zh: 如果我们能将其稳定的话……
label.en: If it could somehow be stabilized...

descriptions.zh:
对[From.GetName]高空轨道的高速物体进行扫描的尝试失败了。物体很快便从视野中消失，而科研船的各项仪器根本无法跟上它的速度。

虽然[From.GetName]的引力强度很大，但该物体的移动速度依旧令人难以置信。要么是这个物体本身带有什么非凡属性，要么就是引力的奇迹造成了这一奇景。

物体的速度似乎正在逐渐增加，科研官员[Root.GetLeaderName]认为就算没有外界干预，该物体也很可能即将被抛出轨道。
descriptions.en:
Attempts to scan the object in high-speed orbit of [From.GetName] have been unsuccessful. The object quickly falls below [From.GetName]'s horizon and the [Root.GetName]'s instruments are simply unable to keep up.

While [From.GetName]'s gravitational pull is strong, that alone does little to explain the object's extreme momentum. Either the object itself possesses some extraordinary properties, or there is some gravitational phenomenon at work here.

The object's velocity appears to be increasing over time, and Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suspects that it may soon be thrown out of orbit, even without outside interference.

tooltips.zh: 派出无人机进行拖拽，以求降低其动量。
tooltips.en: Dispatch a drone and attempt to latch onto the object to reduce its momentum.

tooltips.zh: 投掷废物与其相撞，以求打乱其轨道运行。
tooltips.en: Eject debris to collide with the object, hopefully stopping it in its orbital tracks.

tooltips.zh: 离开危险区域，让这物体自生自灭。
tooltips.en: Move out of harm's way and leave the object to its fate.

descriptions.zh:
投掷的废物成功与未知物体相撞，降低了其飞行速度，并令其掉出了轨道。[Root.GetName]不久后成功将其回收。

该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
descriptions.en:
The ejected debris successfully collided with the unknown object, reducing its velocity before knocking it out of orbit. The [Root.GetName] was able to retrieve it soon thereafter.

The object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

descriptions.zh:
无人机已成功停止了未知物体的轨道飞行。

无人机放出拉索拖拽物体，逐渐降低其速度，最终成功将其引导至[Root.GetName]并进行了回收。

该物体类似盒子，由外星材质构成，外部具有如血管般的突脊，一路延伸至顶部的一个球状机构。至于其内含何物目前尚不得而知。
descriptions.en:
The drone successfully intercepted the unknown object's orbit.

By latching onto the object and then thrusting in reverse little by little, the drone was eventually able to direct it to the [Root.GetName] for retrieval.

The object looks to be some sort of box, constructed of alien material. Vein-like ridges meander along its sides, congregating at the top in some type of sphere-shaped mechanism. We can only guess at its contents.

tooltips.zh: 将这外星盒子射入深空。
tooltips.en: Shoot the alien box into deep space.

descriptions.zh:
历经长久努力，我们的科学家终于穿透了外星盒子的外部材料。

盒子内装着的三个小型容器，的确分别盛有不同的液体——一种§R红色§!，一种§B蓝色§!，还有一种§G绿色§!。这些液体比外面的容器更为常见，我方科学家已确定其为基因改造媒介。

出于未知原因，溶液移出外星容器后开始急剧腐坏，但我们尚有足够时间开始人工合成其中的一种，并将其应用于我们的物种。目前已确定其效果一定有益，但具体如何有益尚不明确。
descriptions.en:
At long last, our scientists have penetrated the outer material of the alien box.

The three small vials inside are indeed filled with different liquids - one §Rred§!, one §Bblue§!, and one §Ggreen§!. The liquids are less alien than their container and our scientists have identified them as primed gene-modification mediums.

For reasons beyond our understanding, the solutions are quickly deteriorating outside their alien container, but there should be enough time to synthesize and apply one of them to our species. It has been confirmed that its effects would be positive, but exactly how remains to be seen.

descriptions.zh:
我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]终于在不破坏盒子的情况下调查出了盒内的情况。通过使用先进的声呐系统，他们成功确认了盒子的内容物。

里面的物品十分令人困惑，也可以说是出人意料。里面装着三个小型容器，每个里面都装着一种未知的液体。

盒子是可以安全打开的，但想要找出打开的办法还需要更多的研究。
descriptions.en:
Finally, our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have managed a peek into the alien box without compromising the container itself. By utilizing an advanced type of sonar, they have been able to identify its contents.

The contents are puzzling or, at least, unexpected. The box holds three small vials, each filled with an unknown liquid.

The box is safe to open, but it will require further research to understand how.

tooltips.zh: 对盒子的研究加速了我们对£physics£ §Y物理学§!知识的了解。
tooltips.en:
Research of the box has accelerated
our £physics£ §YPhysics§! knowledge.

tooltips.en: Sell the box to the highest bidder.

tooltips.zh: 对盒子的研究加速了我们对£physics£ §Y物理学§!知识的了解。
tooltips.en:
Research of the box has accelerated
our £physics£ §YPhysics§! knowledge.

tooltips.zh: 通过中子活化分析，我们可以更好地了解制作盒子的材料和内容。
tooltips.en: Through neutron activation analysis, we can better understand what materials were used to make the box and the contents.

descriptions.zh:
我们早已精通合成以及发展独特染色体的能力，结果完全不出意料。我们成功地将§R红色§!、§G绿色§!和§B蓝色§!的溶液一起施加给了[root.GetSpeciesName]物种。

我们的物种现在更加融洽、适应且长寿了。
descriptions.en:
As masters of synthesizing and deploying unique genomes the outcome was never in doubt. We have managed to apply the §Rred§!, §Ggreen§!, and §Bblue§! solutions to the [root.GetSpeciesName] species.

Our species is now more social, adaptable, and longer-lived.

descriptions.zh:
§R红色§!基因改造溶液已成功注入[Root.GetSpeciesName]人民。

根据对早期实验对象的初步观察，这种溶液似乎会让我们变得更加合群。
descriptions.en:
The §Rred§! gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to make us more social.

descriptions.zh:
§G绿色§!溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。

基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以增强我们对环境的适应能力。
descriptions.en:
The §Ggreen§! gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to improve our ability to adapt to our environment.

descriptions.zh:
§B蓝色§!溶液已成功用于对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]民众的改造。

基于对第一批实验对象的观察，这种溶液似乎可以延长我们的寿命。
descriptions.en:
The §Bblue§! gene-modification solution has been successfully administered to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people.

Based on preliminary observations of early subjects, the solution appears to increase our potential lifespan.

descriptions.zh: 尽管初期结果乐观，基因改造最终不幸失败，因为这种溶液与更加普遍的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]基因组不相容。
descriptions.en: The attempted gene modification was unfortunately a failure despite promising initial results, as the solutions proved incompatible with the wider [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] genome.

descriptions.zh:
根据目前观察，在[breathing_rift_object.GetName]发现的异常现象似乎是极为罕见的空间裂隙。很有可能是[breathing_rift_object.GetName]的巨大质量帮助其生成，但我们目前尚无法理解其性质。

裂隙不仅会折射和阻挡光线，而且似乎还会吸引光线后再将其吐出，如此往复——有如呼吸一般。

目前看来，裂隙巨大的引力很可能也拉入过其他东西。我们最好小心行事。
descriptions.en:
The anomaly found close by [breathing_rift_object.GetName], however unlikely, appears to be some type of rift in space. It's possible the great mass of [breathing_rift_object.GetName] somehow caused it, but its nature is beyond our understanding.

The rift not only refracts and blocks light, but seems to actually draw it in and then push it out, repeatedly - as if it were breathing photons.

It is likely the immense gravitational pull of the rift has at some point inhaled in other things, as well. We should exercise caution.

label.zh: 有进一步发现之前，一定要紧密观察。
label.en: Keep a close watch until we know more.

descriptions.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品是小行星的遗留碎片，其中大部分仍然富含矿物。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
descriptions.en:
Once again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] has released a sizeable gathering of items. This time it's remnants of an asteroid, many of them laden with minerals.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

descriptions.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量富含矿物的岩石从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
descriptions.en:
Many months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] without anything out of the ordinary happening. But now, we have received reports of a large gathering of mineral-laden rocks pouring out of it.

They are ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

descriptions.zh:
[breathing_rift_object.GetName]又一次放出了数量十分可观的物品。这次的物品漂流进入该星系的碎料，也许是某次古代战斗留下的遗迹吧。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
descriptions.en:
Again, the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName] spews out something new. This time it is mostly metal debris, perhaps from some ancient battle. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

descriptions.zh:
自从发现[breathing_rift_object.GetName]附近的裂隙，已经过去了几个月之久，但没有发生任何意外。但现在，我们收到了有关大量碎料从其中倾泻而出的报告。

就等着我们去收集。

我们会继续对裂隙进行观察。
descriptions.en:
Many uneventful months have passed since the discovery of the rift near [breathing_rift_object.GetName]. But now, we have received reports of a great stream of debris pouring out of it. It is ours for the taking.

Observation of the rift will continue.

descriptions.zh: 从观察裂隙的勘测器传来的最新数据表明，裂隙已经消失了。吸入最后一口气之后，裂隙自动关闭，且未留下任何其曾经存在过的能源痕迹。
descriptions.en: The latest data report from the rift's observation probe tells us that the rift has vanished. After drawing its last breath, the rift closed and left behind not even a trace of its energies.
